name: Stripe
one_liner: Payments platform with a broad REST API, OpenAPI specs, official SDKs, webhooks and a hosted MCP server.
auth_notes: Secret and restricted API keys per account (test sandbox and live). OAuth 2.0 via Stripe Apps to act on behalf of other Stripe accounts.
access_notes: Keys are generated on account creation; sandbox keys work immediately. Live-mode money movement requires account activation (business verification). No per-call fee for API access.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve keys and sandbox, documented broad REST API with OpenAPI specs and webhooks. Live mode needs account activation; multi-account OAuth requires building a Stripe App.

disputes.why: Docs: keys generated on account creation, sandbox and live; live mode needs account setup.
OpenAPI spec covers v1 and v2 endpoints; many named operations with separate rate limits.
Vendor GitHub org lists official SDK repos.
Stripe Apps OAuth page describes redirect-and-install authorization flow.
